read.title: Launch Plan: Glow Vitamin C Serum
read.text:
Team,

We're excited to announce that our Glow Vitamin C Serum will launch on December 1. A 15-second teaser will go live on Instagram and TikTok on November 24, and pre-orders will open on our online store starting from November 26.

Twenty partner creators will receive the product this week and post reviews on launch day. Please make sure all posts follow the new brand guide, especially the color tone and product claims.

Thanks,
Minsu

write.en: Write a short notice to partner creators about the launch date, teaser date, and pre-order start date of a new product.
write.model:
Hi everyone,

We're excited to announce that our new Cica Calming Cream will launch on January 10. Our teaser video will go live on January 3, and pre-orders will be available starting from January 5. Your product kits will arrive next week, so please plan your posts for launch day.

Thank you,
Minsu
